title: ABC Dinamo: a voice of its own, jokes included
note: The foundry site is full of jokes in its own voice: the cookie banner is a hand holding a fortune cookie, the header says "5 online", the copy ends "it's free! <333", and there is a shop for hardware with smiley stickers. Flat yellow sections, grey pills, plain grotesk. Worth taking: personality from words and odd details, not from effects.
